heroSub: Your reputation reflects your trust, expertise, and contribution to the community. It's built from two pillars: Social Capital and Trust Score.

socialCapital.title: Social Capital
socialCapital.sub: Measures your activity, influence, and value to the community
socialCapital.desc: Social Capital grows as you contribute to the platform. Every meaningful action earns you points. The more you engage — creating events, building connections, growing the network — the higher your rank.
socialCapital.referralDesc: Invite someone who joins the platform
socialCapital.joinCommunityDesc: Become a member of a community
socialCapital.ranksDesc: As your Social Capital grows, you unlock higher ranks that reflect your standing in the community.

trustScore.title: Trust Score
trustScore.sub: Reflects your identity verification and reliability (0–100)
trustScore.desc: Trust Score shows how verified and reliable you are. It's based on profile completeness, identity verification, and your behavior on the platform. A higher Trust Score means the community can rely on you more.
trustScore.newMemberDesc: New to the platform. Build trust by completing your profile and participating.
trustScore.verifiedDesc: Profile is partially verified. Active member with growing credibility.
trustScore.highlyTrustedDesc: Fully verified and highly reliable. Your actions carry more weight.

together.title: How They Work Together
together.sub: Trust Score amplifies your Social Capital earnings
together.desc: Your Trust Score directly affects how much Social Capital you earn. Higher trust means your contributions are valued more. When your actions award points to others, your trust multiplier applies.

stayActive.title: Stay Active
stayActive.desc: To keep the system fair, accounts inactive for 60 days lose 5% of their Social Capital. Stay engaged to maintain your rank and influence.
